sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100 housings – our counterproposal and request for a cost breakdown
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and for twelve years of reliable supply.

We would like a solution that keeps your foundry healthy. However, +8.8 % is hard for us to follow. By your own figures, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % and makes up 28 % of your cost, which works out to roughly 0.9 % on the unit price.

Could you share a cost breakdown for PH-100, showing energy, metal, labour and overhead? That would help us understand the rest of the increase.

In return, we can offer planning security: a 24-month commitment for 4,000 housings per year. Please see the attached alternatives.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your offer of a 24-month commitment, which provides valuable planning security for our foundry. Building on your second alternative, we can accept the 45-day payment terms and the January 2027 start date. In return for these extended terms, we are prepared to reduce our price to €51.60 per unit.

Our current Angebot is a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100: revised alternatives for a 24-month agreement
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for moving to EUR 51.60 and for accepting the 24-month frame.

Our reasoning comes from your own figures. WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % and makes up 28 % of your cost, which adds about 0.9 % to the unit price.

We understand that SCRAP-E3 and GAS-TTF matter too. Could you tell us roughly what share of your cost each one represents? Then we can look at the remaining gap together, with figures on both sides.

We want your foundry to stay healthy. We have attached three revised packages and are flexible on the start date and the payment terms.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

Guten Tag,

Thank you for your revised alternatives and your continued commitment to our partnership. Demo Gießerei GmbH values the long history between our companies deeply, and we are glad to keep working together. 

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Building on your first alternative, we are prepared to lower our price to €51.30 per unit. Please understand that our internal cost structures and specific material shares remain confidential. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.

For this price of €51.30 per unit, our current Angebot includes a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100: closing the remaining gap
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for moving to EUR 51.30. We respect that your cost shares stay confidential.

We are close to an agreement. We would like to close with a fair package that keeps the foundry healthy and gives us a price we can defend internally.

We remain ready to commit to 24 months at 4,000 housings per year. We are also flexible on how we balance price, start date and payment terms. Please see the three attached packages. Could you tell us which one works best for you?

If none of them fits, could you tell us your preferred trade-off between payment days and the start date?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your flexibility and your commitment to finding a fair package. As a proud family foundry with a long tradition, we value our strong relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH deeply. 

Our offer stands at a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. Building on your first alternative, we are prepared to reduce our price to €51.20 per unit to close the remaining gap. This maintains the January 2027 start date and 45-day payment terms, which we prefer over a delayed start. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €51.20 per unit, a price of €51.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100: final step towards agreement
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for the two options and for moving to EUR 51.20. We appreciate the effort and understand your preference for a January start.

We are very close. To let us close this week, we propose meeting a little further:
- EUR 51.10, 45 days net, 24 months, from 1 January 2027, or
- EUR 51.20, 45 days net, 24 months, from 1 February 2027.

Both packages keep the full 24-month commitment of 4,000 housings per year. They give your foundry stable volume and give us a price we can sign off internally.

If either works for you, we are ready to confirm.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

move.subject: PH-100: confirming your EUR 51.20 option
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your clear position and for the reliable supply your team delivers.

In your previous message you offered EUR 51.20 per unit, 45 days net, 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027. We are ready to confirm exactly that package now, with the full commitment of 4,000 housings per year over two years.

If a February start suits you better, we can also sign EUR 51.30, 45 days net, 24 months, from 1 February 2027.

Both packages are attached. Please let us know which one you prefer, and we will confirm straight away.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing
